newsitem.title: USA: Party City Q2 same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Party City Q2 same-store sales rise.

text.p: Party City Corp said on Thursday second quarter same-store sales rose 10.3 percent.
Total revenues rose to $22.5 million from $8.3 million for the same period last year, the company said.
Sales from stores increased to $20.1 million from $6.3 million for the second quarter of last year, it said.

For the first six months of 1997, total revenues rose to $41.1 million from $14.3 million for the same period last year. Sales increased to $36.7 million from $10.9 million a year ago. Same-store sales increased 13.2 percent.
